text:
Introduction
This document outlines the Isusu car 
 pick up inspection steps I1, which must be carried out on daily.
The car technical data:
 Type: Isusu Car Pickup, No. of Engine: 432, 
 Chassis : 7156784, 
 Wight : I,46 Ton
The first draft 
 initiated by eng. Mohamed Alaa Eldin, tested by eng. Aiman Mohamed Shabana, revised 
 by EDEPC quality control eng. Samir Abdel Gilel, accepted by general director 
 eng. Mohamed Nageb and approved by eng. Mostafa Alam Head Sector of Talkha PS.
Safety 
Precaution
Safety Belt must be on.
Fire Chimney mast be on.
Jake for tires.
Tools and 
Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set .
Cleaning fluid, Rag wipe,
Screw drivers.
Work to be Carried out
Check wheel nuts for looseness.
Check operation of lights.
Check for any oil, water, fuel and brake fluid 
 leakage.
Check parking brake lever travel.
Check operation of horn 0.
Check operation of instruments and indicator 
 light.
Check level of fuel in the fuel tank.
Check the setting angle of the rear view 
 mirrors.
Check engine oil level.
Check fan belt tension.
